title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
description: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

title: Forward Industries Raises $25 Million to Expand Solana Treasury - CryptoRank
description: Forward Industries Raises $25 Million to Expand Solana Treasury  CryptoRank

title: Strategy Sets New BTC Holdings Record After $143M Bitcoin Purchase
description: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin treasury firm bought 1,665 BTC last week, taking its holdings above its previous record to 847,666 BTC.

title: Months After the $292M Kelp Hack, Chainlink Lets Institutions Add Their Own Bridge Checks
description: Chainlink's CCIP 2.0 lets banks run their own security checks on cross-chain transfers, five months after a rival's setup lost $292 million to hackers.

title: SEC Staff Says Token Buybacks Don't Make Crypto a Security—If the Network Works
description: New SEC staff guidance says announcing a token buyback on a functional network isn't a promise that turns the token into a security, a shift one attorney says makes securities laws look "opt-in."

title: Is the Red September Curse Over? Bitcoin Set for Best September on Record
description: Bitcoin is up 7.33% in September, edging past 2024 as the best September on record, with one day left before the monthly candle closes.

title: Anthropic Lost $42 Billion Last Year. It Wants to Go Public at $2 Trillion
description: The company's IPO prospectus shows revenue up twelvefold, a $518 billion spending plan, and a risk section warning that its own AI could pose existential risks to humanity.

title: Bitwise Launches First US Spot Near ETF After Token Nearly Triples Since August
description: Bitwise's NRR began trading on NYSE Arca Tuesday, giving brokerage accounts NEAR exposure and staking rewards as the AI-focused token soars.

title: Trump Unveils 'Morally Binding' AI Accord Signed by OpenAI, Google and Nvidia
description: The one-page pact, which Trump called "morally binding," asks companies to adopt internal controls, independent audits and board oversight—but carries no penalties and drew criticism for its thin detail.
